prompt: a watermleon is $2.99lb, and one watermelon steve wants is 6 pounds. How much will it cost.
response:
To find out how much the watermelon will cost, you need to multiply the price per pound by the weight of the watermelon. Given that the price is $2.99 per pound and the watermelon Steve wants is 6 pounds, the calculation is as follows:

\[ \text{Cost} = 2.99 \, \text{dollars/lb} \times 6 \, \text{lb} \]

\[ \text{Cost} = 17.94 \, \text{dollars} \]

So, the watermelon will cost Steve $17.94.
